title: Allegro barbaro (arr. orchestra, Johnson)
notable_excerpt: Opening (00:00); play the score MIDI in the browser to audition.
video_use_ideas: Pounding, primal momentum for a fight, chase or tribal ritual scene.
legal_notes: Composition: Béla Bartók (d. 1945), first published 1918 (Universal Edition), so public domain in the US (published before 1931) and in the EU / life+70 countries. File: orchestral arrangement/MIDI by Johnson (2021), IMSLP file #867623, licence CC BY 4.0 as labelled on IMSLP: credit 'Arrangement: Johnson (2021), CC BY 4.0, via IMSLP #867623'. Not Bartók's own piano original. Length ~2:55.
